description: Cluster-aware, cross-fitted inference for the balanced 20-author punctuation evaluation instrument.

estimands.llm_imitability: Author-equal mean target-author attribution accuracy with the prompt-source book excluded.
estimands.model_difference: Paired author-level difference in imitability between Flash and Pro.
estimands.detection: Out-of-fold AUC, empirical human false-positive rate, and LLM true-positive rate at a threshold calibrated on other authors.
estimands.separability: Association between cross-fitted human-only D/C and attribution of books excluded from D/C construction.
estimands.positional_stability: Author-equal first-to-fifth-window change in target KL and attribution geometry.

claim_policy.primary_panel: The screened 20-author panel is the primary conditional evaluation population.
claim_policy.frozen_panel: The frozen 10-author analysis is retained as discovery and replication evidence.
claim_policy.pooled_references: Pooled-reference results are leakage contrasts, not headline estimates.
claim_policy.run_level_tests: Run-level binomial tests are descriptive and are not used as population-level inference.
claim_policy.novelty: The contribution is the integrated leakage-controlled evaluation instrument, not KL, punctuation features, or the language models.
